thresholds.effectSummary: Paralysis is negated.

thresholds.effectSummary: Sleep is negated.

Stun chance is doubled.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Negates Mud and Snow effects.

thresholds.effectSummary: Mud and Snowman effects are negated.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Reduces or increases attention from a monster when fighting in a group.

thresholds.effectSummary: Monsters are less likely to target you.
Monsters are more likely to target you.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases health gauge.

thresholds.effectSummary: Increases maximum Health by 50.
Increases maximum Health by 20.
Decreases maximum Health by 10.
Decreases maximum Health by 30.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases or decreases recovery speed of the red health bar after taking damage.

thresholds.effectSummary: Red-health recovery is 4× faster.
Red-health recovery is 2× faster.
Red-health recovery is 1/2 as fast.
Red-health recovery is 1/4 as fast.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Decreases or increases rate of weapon sharpness consumption. (Blademaster only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Sharpness consumption is halved; a non-deflecting attack may consume no sharpness.
Sharpness consumption is doubled.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases overall weapon sharpness. (Blademaster only)

thresholds.effectSummary: The sharpness gauge is +1 level longer; no change when already at maximum.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Attacks do not bounce. (Blademaster only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Attacks do not bounce; the deflect sharpness penalty is unchanged.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases or decreases weapon critical chance.

thresholds.effectSummary: Increases Affinity by 30%.
Increases Affinity by 20%.
Increases Affinity by 10%.
Decreases Affinity by 5%.
Decreases Affinity by 10%.
Decreases Affinity by 15%.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases or decreases speed of sharpening. (Blademaster only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Sharpening motion is shorter (4→1 actions).
Sharpening takes longer (4→5 actions).

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Decreases or increases knock back and damage when guarding. (Blademaster only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Guarding greatly reduces knockback and damage.
Guarding reduces knockback and damage.
Guarding causes greater knockback and increased damage.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Allows guarding against normally unblockable attacks. (Blademaster only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Allows guarding attacks that normally cannot be guarded.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Automatically blocks attacks when weapon is drawn. (Blademaster only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Automatically guards attacks while the weapon is drawn when guarding is possible.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Decreases or increases speed of reloading (Gunner only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Bowgun reload is 3 stages faster; bow coatings need no loading.
Bowgun reload is 2 stages faster; bow coatings need no loading.
Bowgun reload is 1 stage faster and bow-coating loading is faster.
Bowgun reload is 1 stage slower and bow-coating loading is slightly slower.
Bowgun reload is 2 stages slower and bow-coating loading is slower.
Bowgun reload is 3 stages slower and bow-coating loading is much slower.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Decreases or increases recoil of bowgun shots. (Bowgun only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Bowgun recoil is reduced by 3 stages.
Bowgun recoil is reduced by 2 stages.
Bowgun recoil is reduced by 1 stage.
Bowgun recoil is increased by 1 stage.
Bowgun recoil is increased by 2 stages.
Bowgun recoil is increased by 3 stages.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases the power of Normal S and Rapid shots (Gunner only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Normal ammo and Rapid arrows deal 1.1× power.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases the power of Pierce S and Pierce shots (Gunner only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Pierce ammo and Pierce arrows deal 1.1× power.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases the power of Pellet S and Scatter shots (Gunner only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Pellet ammo deals 1.2× power; Spread arrows deal 1.3× power.

thresholds.effectSummary: Allows loading all levels of Normal ammo; capacity varies by weapon.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Adds Pierce S to current types of loadable ammo. (Bowgun only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Allows loading all levels of Pierce ammo; capacity varies by weapon.
Allows loading Lv1 Pierce ammo; capacity varies by weapon.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Adds Pellet S to current types of loadable ammo. (Bowgun only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Allows loading all levels of Pellet ammo; capacity varies by weapon.
Allows loading Lv1 Pellet ammo; capacity varies by weapon.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Adds Crag S to current types of loadable ammo. (Bowgun only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Allows loading all levels of Crag ammo; capacity varies by weapon.
Allows loading Lv1 Crag ammo; capacity varies by weapon.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Adds Clust S to current types of loadable ammo. (Bowgun only)

thresholds.effectSummary: Allows loading all levels of Cluster ammo, one round each.
Allows loading Lv1 Cluster ammo, one round.

thresholds.effectSummary: Element values are 1.1× (1.2× for bowguns); stacks with each elemental attack skill.
Element values are 0.9×; stacks with each elemental attack skill.

skillTrees.inGameDescription: Increases the power and combining success rate of bombs.

thresholds.effectSummary: Bomb damage is 1.3× and bomb-item combination success is 100%.

Decreases Attack by 15.

thresholds.effectSummary: Items cannot be stolen.
